_note: Copy to .superdesign/src/config.json. prefix: the root id ({prefix}-root) and the Pause animation storage key. brand_urls: Superdesign brand-asset URLs written by upload.py, used as brand('logo'). forbidden: strings that must never ship (old brand names, misspellings, the agency's name). contract: warn | error | off for the React handoff checks. eyebrows: false warns on .eyebrow (house rule). reference_pages: boards skipped by the handoff checks and the block inventory. frame_width / mobile_width / mobile_pattern / frame_widths: canvas frame widths (import_drafts.py). check_fonts: families measure.js and render.js require. motion: false drops the GSAP layer. gsap: the pinned GSAP version for drafts. app: the handoff target (next or vite).
